hazards.control: Test the stack to the program pressures; bleed and verify zero before breaking any connection.
BOP drills before the job; kill weight fluid or a tested barrier before the tree comes off.

name: Drilling spool with kill and choke outlets
function: The flanged spool below the rams whose two side outlets take the kill line (pump in) and the choke line (flow out under control).

tabs.overview: Outlets valved with a manual and a hydraulic valve each on full stacks; the choke line runs to the choke manifold.
tabs.engineering: API Spec 16A; rating with the stack.
tabs.safety: Outlet valves tested with the stack.
tabs.evidence: API Spec 16A (S48), API Std 53 (S49), API RP 16ST (S53), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
